frequency_question: What is the frequency of central bank activations of the countercyclical capital buffer among G-SIFI jurisdictions during prolonged credit expansion phases?
membership_rule: Includes G20 banking jurisdictions establishing a Basel III-aligned countercyclical capital buffer framework between 2016 and 2026. Excludes microprudential capital surcharges and liquidity requirements.

cases.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB Activation

coverage_note: 6 named peer activations; believed roughly 8 to 10 total major jurisdictions activated a non-zero buffer at least once post-2016.
known_gaps: The U.S. framework relies heavily on a standardized vulnerability scorecard rather than purely discretionary macroprudential boards, making mechanical cross-country translation imperfect.
skeleton: G-10 central banking jurisdictions with operational Basel III frameworks maintaining a 0% baseline CCyB during non-crisis credit expansions.
multiplier: 3 active implementation attempts across 10 eligible peer jurisdictions over a 10-year structural window.
validity_reason: Tied directly to the terminal resolution date of the primary question.
